result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one section heading renders a raw localization key instead of translated text, and the favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized string such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry for 'home_feed.popular_title' and provide a fallback label so untranslated keys never render to users.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use different styles — the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark circle with a white heart — creating inconsistent visual treatment.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon colors across all restaurant cards, using a consistent scrim/backdrop for legibility over any image.
